lines.en: I sink to my knees in the snow.
My footprints are wide and deep.
I walk slowly, one step at a time.
Only my steps sound on the snowfield.
My coat is thick; I do not mind cold.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方雪都塌了
lines.en: The snow collapses where I pass.
I shake ice off my arms.
I walk clumsily, but steadily.
I sniff the air as I walk.

lines.zh: 远处的雪坡是我常走的
lines.en: That far slope is my usual path.
One foot flattens a patch of snow.
I walk with my back to the wind.
The ice cracked under me.
My breath comes out in white clouds.
I crouch down in the snow.
New frost crusts over my white fur.
I scoop up a handful of snow.
I am watching the mountain.
I stay warm without moving.
Frost has crusted my fur.
Sitting, I look like a boulder.
I listen for anyone in the wind.
I brush snow off myself.
I yawn, loudly.
I am quiet, but very large.
I look up at the sky.
I grind my teeth slowly.
This cold suits me.
I dig my hands into the snow.
I wait for the wind to die down.
You have very little fur.
You are dressed far too lightly.
I lower my head to look at you.
You should not walk this snowfield.
Your footprints are small.
I tilt my head, copying you.
You are not as tall as I am.
You need to stay near the fire.
That blade does not frighten me.
Why are you looking at my teeth?
I let out a loud cry.
My footprints sink deep into the snow.
My fur is parted.
I shook my head about.
I hold my shoulder.
I am rarely struck at all.
That punch carries weight.
I crouch to shield myself.
Do that again and I will get cross.
Will this fill a belly?
I prefer berries.

lines.zh: 你举得那么高，我够得到
lines.en: You hold it high; I can still reach.
Let me sniff it first.
Keep it for the winter.
My teeth are for grinding.
This thing is far too hard.
Set it down and I will take it.
I do not take from people.
Half is enough for me.
You get hungry faster than I do.
I eat plants; no meat.
I have never tasted this.
Thank you; I rarely meet people.
You stumbled into the snow by my leg.
I hurried to step back.
I was afraid of treading on you.
You sank halfway into the snow.
The fur on me is very soft.
Is there snow on you?
I crouch down; do not be afraid.
The snow gave way under me.
You are pressed into my fur.
I only want to eat and sleep.
Talk of that in winter.
I am too clumsy for this.
Do not worry; I would not.
I do fine on my own.
Companions are few on the snowfield.
I buried my face in my fur.
You should go somewhere warm.
Let me eat in peace.
I picked it up; my hands are clumsy.

lines.zh: 这东西在我手里像颗石子
lines.en: It feels like a pebble in my hand.
I pinch it between two fingers.
It looks pitiful in my hand.
I nearly crushed it.
You dropped this? Here.
Bending down is hard for me.
A layer of snow has settled on it.
I place it in your hand.
Do not drop it in the snow again.
You have gone much too far.
The snowfield is not safe.
I will walk along with you.
I will not let you go that way.
There is a cliff that way.
Listen; the wind sounds wrong.
I stand in front of the wind.
You go first; I guard the rear.
I will shield you.
Do not fear; I am big.
I am following behind you.
The snow is deep; you are slow.
You can walk in my tracks.
We are near the mountain's foot.
You are shivering.
Let me block the wind for you.
There is a crevasse ahead.
I go around; you follow.
We are not there yet.
With me here, you will not fall.
I will only give a light push.
My arm sweeps across.
You are pushed down into the snow.
I do not want to hurt you.
You are half buried in snow.
I brush the snow off you.
Get behind the snowbank.
I am strong and cannot stop easily.
Do not come any closer.
A mound rises in the snow.
I stand taller than the trees.
I shake the snow off.
I come out of a snowdrift.
I know this place well.
A big shadow joins the snowfield.
My breath comes out white.
I turn slowly to look at you.
Do not fear; I do not eat people.

lines.zh: 火让我想起不愉快的事
lines.en: Fire brings back bad memories.
The icy water locks me up.
The blast lifted me off my feet.
An arrow sank into my thick fur.
The spell makes me dizzy.
Winters are hard to endure.
Lightning struck my back.
No snow here, no ground either.
